999008199.text:
もうすぐ夜だね……
この赤い空も、もう見慣れたもんですわ

localizations.en: It's almost nighttime... I've really gotten used to this red sky.

999008199.text:
そうね。最初はなかなか見慣れなかったけど、
この空は時間の経過が分かりやすくて、むしろいいわね

localizations.en: I know. It was hard to get used to at first, but this sky actually makes it easier to tell what time it is. I've come to appreciate it.

999008199.text:
元の世界に帰ったら、この空も
見れなくなっちゃうんだよね～。アルビちゃん残念

localizations.en: Once we go back to our world, we won't be able to see this sky anymore... What a bummer.

999008199.text: 姉様、この空のこと気に入った？

localizations.en: Alvina, do you like this sky?

999008199.text:
うん！　結構好き！
空もだけど、この世界が！

localizations.en: Yeah! I really do! Not just the sky, though—I like this whole world!

999008199.text:
そりゃ最初は、常識が違う世界にいきなり来ちゃって
すっごく不安だったけど……

localizations.en: Sure, at first I was super anxious about suddenly ending up in a world where everything works differently...

999008199.text:
今は、ほのかとマリーに出会えたこともあって、
この世界が結構好きになったんだ！

localizations.en: But now, after meeting Honoka and Marie, I've grown pretty fond of this place!

999008199.text:
なんといっても、あの配信ってやつは天才だよね。
あれがアタシたちの世界にもあったらなぁ～

localizations.en: And that streaming thing? That's pure genius. I wish we had something like that back in our world!

999008199.text:
ふふ、配信がとっても気に入ったのね。
確かに、アルビーナの性格に合ってる気がする

localizations.en: Hehe, you really took to streaming, didn't you? I have to say, it does suit your personality.

999008199.text:
姉様なら配信で天下をとれるわ。
「星の案内人による無数島群域ツアー配信」とかどう？

localizations.en: You'd take the streaming world by storm. How about "The Star Guide's Infinite Island Chain Tour Stream"?

999008199.text:
おー！　いいねベップ！　それ採用！
あとはスマホをどう持ち帰るかだけど～……

localizations.en: Oh! I love it! That's the one! Now I just need to figure out how to bring a smartphone back with me...

999008199.text:
こらこら。
こっちの世界のものを持って帰るのは禁止だよ

localizations.en: Now, now. You can't take things from this world back with you.

999008199.text: あ、イェルカ

でも、アルビーが配信に積極的で良かったよ。
おかげで、すぐお前さんたちのこと見つけられたからね

localizations.en: But I'm glad you got into streaming. Made it real easy to track you all down.

999008199.text: ん？　どういうこと？

アルビーとレスナが臨時ヴィーナスってやつで
話題になっているのをたまたま耳にしてね

localizations.en: I happened to hear people talking about how you and Resna were the special guest Venuses making waves.

999008199.text:
そうだったのね。
さすが姉様とレスナ。作戦通りだわ

localizations.en: I see. That's our Alvina and Resna. Everything went according to plan.

999008199.text:
イェルカのことだから、てっきり私たちの居場所は
最初から分かっていたんだと思っていたわ

localizations.en: Knowing you, I figured you already knew where we were from the start.

999008199.text:
ところで、私たちが世界を渡ったきっかけって
結局のところなんだったの？

localizations.en: By the way, what exactly caused us to cross worlds in the first place?

999008199.text:
簡単に言うと、パルメ族が管理しているものに
不測の事態が起きちゃってね。そんな感じ

localizations.en: To put it simply, something the Palme were managing ran into an unexpected problem. Something like that.

999008199.text:
どんな感じだい！
ま、詳しくは教えてくれないんでしょ。どーせ

localizations.en: Something like that? Well, I'm guessing you're not going to give us the details anyway.

999008199.text: あはは。悪いね、アルビー

詳しくは答えられないけど、ちゃんと全員、
元の世界にしっかり帰すから安心しな

localizations.en: I can't go into the details, but I promise everyone will return safely to their own world.

999008199.text:
当たり前！　ちゃんと責任とってよね！
むしろお詫びで何かもらいたいくらいだよ！

localizations.en: You'd better! Take some responsibility here! Actually, I think we deserve some kind of apology gift!

999008199.text:
それなら、もう十分貰ったって考えられるんじゃない？
ほのかたちとの出会いや、ここで見た色んな景色とか

localizations.en: Haven't you already received plenty? Meeting Honoka and the others, seeing all these new sights...

999008199.text:
こうしたことがなければ
なかった出会いと経験なんだから

localizations.en: These are encounters and experiences we never would've had otherwise.

999008199.text:
それはそう！
ここはヤンネさんの言葉に免じて許してやろう！

localizations.en: Well, when you put it that way! Fine, I'll let it slide this time—just because you asked so nicely!

999008199.text: さすが姉様。寛大なお心をお持ちだわ

localizations.en: That's our Alvina. You're so generous.

999008199.text: あっはは！　ありがとね！

もうこうなったら明日のフェスで最高の結果を出して、
最高の思い出を持ち帰ってやるー！

localizations.en: All right then! Tomorrow at the festival, I'm going to give it everything I've got and bring back the best memories!

999008199.text: 姉様！　優勝！　姉様！　最高！
待ってろ、ヴィーナスフェスっ！！

ところで……オーナーさんにもらったお菓子を
娘へのお土産にしたいのだけど……

localizations.en: By the way... I was hoping to bring back those sweets the Owner gave me as a souvenir for my daughter...

999008199.text:
食べ物もダーメ！
もらったものは帰る前に食べちゃってねー

localizations.en: Food's a no-go too! Make sure you eat everything you were given before you head back.

999008199.text:
そんな悲しそうな顔をしてもダメなもんはダメ！
お土産は思い出話だけにしておくれよ

localizations.en: Even if you give me that sad look, rules are rules! The only souvenirs you're taking back are your stories.
